ROCK BOTTOM PRODUCTIONS: Episode II 🔥

Archetypes ⚡️Authenticity 🧠Addiction 💊Adderall

Writer/Reader vs. Speaker/Listener

The commoditization of X discourse, death of "Business Writing," and authenticity in an LLM world

Drugs and addiction, especially Adderall

TIMESTAMPS ⬇️

(00:00) "The world is changing, and you can get right or get left."

ARCHETYPES 🌓

(01:15) Writer/Reader vs. Speaker/Listener - how the division shows up in communication and relationships (i.e. analyst/PM)
 
(05:30) "The medium is the message." Choosing the right channel - memos vs. podcasts vs. audiobooks vs. transcripts

(10:55) "Great men aren't just great writers or great speakers. They're BOTH." Dual threat, delivery, topic matter selection

(12:30) "Do you read books, or do you READ books?" + Erasmus' In Praise of Folly

AUTHENTICITY 🤖

(14:20) AI, LLMs, the sloppification/commoditization of online discourse, and the complete and total extinction of bullshit "Business Writing"

(16:30) The power of a strong authorial voice, why never to take shortcuts, and the similarities between trading markets and writing.

(19:30) "You can't tell who is human anymore...AI is a wave that just keeps rising and rising and rising. This will only get worse."

(21:25) The vast and underexplored frontier: how can AI improve your writing without selling your soul? Plus, why there is no "right" way to write a book or record a video.

ADDICTION ⚠️

(26:10) Addiction, Adderall, the need for a "voice in the room," and why addiction and habits are two sides of the same coin. "YOU ARE YOUR HABITS."

(30:45) "Your life is a book. What's in the past is written and cannot be changed. All you can do is write today's chapter." Rebuilding your lifestyle, habits and identity.

(33:05) Self-loathing and self-disgust as rocket fuel. "You change, but really, your discipline just becomes stronger than your desire."

(36:45) How people go through decades of their life without being "sober" for a single day, and why it takes 3-6 months just to clear your mind. "Yeah I'm California sober, I just do shrooms every weekend."

(41:10) Poor self-discipline and a lack of structure destroy entrepreneurs more than anything else

ADDERALL 💊

(43:30) The plight of the Adderall office zombie. "What if you got a job that didn't require you to take Adderall?"

(47:00) Mapping the path out from dependency and addiction, battles you fight silently and alone. "If you don't actively change the path you're on, you will keep doing the same shit you are doing until the day you die."

(49:35) "Every rock bottom story ends one of three ways: hospital, jail cell, graveyard." Lasers, daggers, and trvthnvkes. "Pioneers get the arrows, settlers get the land."

(54:00) "All addiction is built on a web of lies." What to do if you see someone struggling with addiction and going down the wrong path. (TL;DR: pray)

(57:00) The Universal Human Experience, the ugly sides of life, and why all change comes from within. "We will know the entire galaxy before we know the inner workings of the human heart."

BONUS BOOK REVIEW 📚

(59:20) La Rochefoucauld's Maxims. "Our virtues are nothing but our vices disguised."
